evidence.title: Generalist AI Releases GEN-1.5: A Robot Foundation Model That Learns New Tasks From One 3–12 Second Demo

summary: Generalist AI announced the release of GEN-1.5, a versatile robot foundation model capable of acquiring new skills after observing just one short demo lasting between three and twelve seconds. The model represents a step toward more adaptable, general-purpose robotic systems that can be programmed on the fly without extensive retraining.
title: Generalist AI unveils GEN-1.5 robot foundation model that learns tasks from a single 3‑12‑second demonstration
